revision_note: Medicine Box v1: exactly 3 separate printable parts. Body 120x85x130 mm with 1 mm wall and a continuous 1 mm thick internal ledge on all four inner sides supporting the removable plate at Z=70 mm. Plate is 1 mm thick, sized to the body cavity with 0.2 mm clearance per side, and has six Ø35 mm holes in a 3x2 pattern facing TOP. Cover is a separate outer cap; body enters cover 60 mm with 0.25 mm clearance per side and 1 mm walls/top. Validate solid geometry and printability before declaring ready.
